evidence_items.finding: landscaping business revenue fell from $780K to $540K in the six months following the handover of ownership
evidence_items.rationale: A 31% revenue decline immediately following ownership handover is a critical adverse acquisition outcome signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: two of the five crew members who were with the business at acquisition have since resigned
evidence_items.rationale: Two crew departures post-acquisition is an adverse staff retention signal. team_capability.

evidence_items.finding: the previous owner completed a two-week handover and has not been in contact with the business since
evidence_items.rationale: A two-week handover after which the previous owner has no further contact is a critical adverse transition signal for a relationship-dependent business. process_maturity; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: the new owner has not been able to establish direct working relationships with the clients who have reduced or stopped ordering
evidence_items.rationale: New owner unable to establish relationships with declining clients is a critical adverse customer retention signal. customer_retention; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: landscaping; revenue fell $780K to $540K; crew unchanged; two-week handover; previous owner gone; client relationships not transferred
Surface signal (not root cause): the crew composition and all operational processes are unchanged from before the acquisition
evidence_items.rationale: Unchanged crew and processes is a misleading signal that the operational failure is the cause — the revenue decline may be relationship-driven rather than operationally driven.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the business services the same geographic area and uses the same equipment and supplier relationships as before
evidence_items.rationale: Unchanged geography, equipment, and suppliers is a misleading signal suggesting external market causes when the decline is concentrated in clients who had direct relationships with the previous owner.

clarification_requests.would_improve_pattern: key_person (revenue concentration in previous owner relationships elevates confidence)

validation_notes: SIM-10-003 is SUPPORTED via key_person_dependency. Revenue collapse after handover due to relationship concentration maps to key-person dependency. No must_identify vocabulary.
